decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The changelog line [ev-983fcb0d825d] is vague, but the linked PR [ev-75d2286d87c9] makes it concrete: the OpenTelemetry (OTLP) metrics provider gains two stable semconv metrics, `http.server.request.duration` and `http.client.request.duration`, and the PR says it adds them rather than replacing anything. The changed files [ev-482260a1d306] confirm the change lives in pkg/metrics/opentelemetry.go and the metrics docs. So the exposed environments are those with OpenTelemetry metrics enabled, and if the operator does nothing, those environments start exporting the two extra metric series. That is an informational, additive consequence. Confidence is low because the PR text doesn't say outright whether the new metrics are always on or need to be enabled, or whether any existing OTLP metric names change.
